cohort: The study included 2,909 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), aged 18-45 years with singleton pregnancies, who delivered at Fujian Maternity and Child Health hospital between 2021 and 2023.
finding: Primiparous and multiparous women with GDM exhibited significantly higher gestational weight gain and reduced risks of pregnancy-induced hypertension, premature rupture of membranes, and delivering large-for-gestational-age newborns or those with neonatal jaundice, compared to nulliparous women.
gest_age: Gestational age (at delivery, and for classification of large-for-gestational-age newborns)
